stem: A phenotypic female child has a 45,X karyotype; which condition does this most likely indicate?
explanation: Turner syndrome is the correct diagnosis for a phenotypic female with a 45,X karyotype.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf

optionExplanations.A: Incorrect because Klinefelter syndrome is typically 47,XXY in a phenotypic male.
optionExplanations.B: Correct because Turner syndrome classically has a 45,X karyotype in a phenotypic female.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because trisomy 13 is Patau syndrome and involves an extra chromosome 13, not 45,X.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because trisomy 18 is Edwards syndrome and involves an extra chromosome 18, not 45,X.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because trisomy 21 is Down syndrome and involves an extra chromosome 21, not 45,X.
